title: Ready For Takeoff
summary: Is the tanker market primed for a turnaround in rates? The tanker market has started the year 2021 with historically low rates. After reaching multi-year highs in the second quarter of last year, freight rates collapsed in the summer as the Covid- 19 pandemic continued to spread and OPEC+ cut oil supply in response to the dramatic drop in global oil demand.
